import { z } from 'zod'

export const ALLOWED_CASE_IDS = [
  'T1',
  'T2',
  'T3',
  'T4',
  'T5',
  'T8',
  'T9',
  'T10',
  'T11a',
  'T11b',
  'T11c',
  'T12',
  'W1',
  'W2',
  'W3',
  'T6-W',
  'T7-W',
  'W9',
  'W11',
  'INT-PERS-01',
  'INT-PERS-02',
  'INT-PERS-03',
  'INT-PERS-04',
] as const

export type CaseId = (typeof ALLOWED_CASE_IDS)[number]

/**
 * Fixed per-case refId requirement table (frozen INTA-1 / R06).
 * refId is required where a fixed record-route case requires it;
 * forbidden on create / fixed-literal / synthetic wire / fault cases without an existing record target.
 */
export const REF_ID_REQUIRED_CASE_IDS: ReadonlySet<CaseId> = new Set<CaseId>([
  'T2',
  'T5',
  'T8',
  'T9',
  'T10',
  'T11a',
  'T11b',
  'T12',
  'W2',
  'W9',
  'W11',
  'INT-PERS-01',
  'INT-PERS-02',
  'INT-PERS-03',
  'INT-PERS-04',
])

export const REF_ID_FORBIDDEN_CASE_IDS: ReadonlySet<CaseId> = new Set<CaseId>([
  'T1',
  'T3',
  'T4',
  'T11c',
  'W1',
  'W3',
  'T6-W',
  'T7-W',
])

export function isRefIdRequired(caseId: CaseId): boolean {
  return REF_ID_REQUIRED_CASE_IDS.has(caseId)
}

export function isRefIdForbidden(caseId: CaseId): boolean {
  return REF_ID_FORBIDDEN_CASE_IDS.has(caseId)
}

const CANONICAL_LOWERCASE_UUID_REGEX =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/

export const harnessCaseInputSchema = z
  .object({
    runId: z
      .string()
      .regex(/^[a-zA-Z0-9]{8,32}$/, 'runId must be 8-32 alphanumeric characters'),
    caseId: z.enum(ALLOWED_CASE_IDS),
    refId: z
      .string()
      .regex(CANONICAL_LOWERCASE_UUID_REGEX, 'refId must be lowercase canonical UUID')
      .optional(),
  })
  .strict()
  .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
    if (isRefIdRequired(data.caseId) && !data.refId) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
        message: `refId is required for case ${data.caseId}`,
        path: ['refId'],
      })
    }
    if (isRefIdForbidden(data.caseId) && data.refId !== undefined) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
        message: `refId is forbidden for case ${data.caseId}`,
        path: ['refId'],
      })
    }
  })

export type HarnessCaseInput = z.infer<typeof harnessCaseInputSchema>

/**
 * Go native User schema with snake_case time fields (INTA-FE-R01).
 * Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC with 0-6 fraction digits.
 */

constructor(runId?: string, stateDir?: string, allowResume = false) {
    this.runId = runId ?? generateRunId()
    this.stateDir = stateDir ?? process.env.MC_INTA_STATE_DIR ?? path.join(process.cwd(), '.run-state')
    this.envelopeDir = path.join(this.stateDir, 'envelopes', this.runId)
    this.checkpointDir = path.join(this.stateDir, 'checkpoints', this.runId)
    this.substepsDir = path.join(this.stateDir, 'substeps', this.runId)
    this.assertionsDir = path.join(this.stateDir, 'assertions')
    this.stagesDir = path.join(this.stateDir, 'stages', this.runId)

    assertNoRunIdCollision(this.runId, undefined, this.stateDir, allowResume)

    fs.mkdirSync(this.envelopeDir, { recursive: true })
    fs.mkdirSync(this.checkpointDir, { recursive: true })
    fs.mkdirSync(this.substepsDir, { recursive: true })
    fs.mkdirSync(this.assertionsDir, { recursive: true })
    fs.mkdirSync(this.stagesDir, { recursive: true })

    this.state = {
      runId: this.runId,
      stage: 'INITIALIZED',
      phase: 'INITIALIZED',
      checkpointA: null,
      checkpointABaseline: null,
      checkpointACurrent: null,
      checkpointBId: null,
      userXOutcome: null,
      envelopes: new Map(),
      assertions: new Map(),
    }

    if (allowResume) {
      this.loadCheckpoint()
      this.loadAssertions()
    }
  }

  // Compatibility getter for checkpointA (returns current state)
  public get checkpointA(): CheckpointUserA | null {
    return this.state.checkpointACurrent
  }

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

# Least privilege for GITHUB_TOKEN: the jobs only read the repository.
permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  quality:
    name: Lint, types, unit tests, build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6 # version comes from "packageManager" in package.json
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      # Runtime dependencies only: the known dev-only advisory (SEC-6) has no fix yet.
      - run: pnpm audit --prod
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm lint
      - run: pnpm format:check
      - run: pnpm agents:check
      - run: pnpm test
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: pnpm build-storybook

  e2e:
    name: E2E (Playwright)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: pnpm test:e2e
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report
          retention-days: 7
